title: Live countdown
text: Counts down to the session deadline, recomputed from the clock on every tick.

title: Opens on time
text: Opens automatically a set time before expiry, at least 20 seconds ahead.

title: Extend or sign out
text: Separate events for staying signed in, signing out, and expiry.

title: Measured announcements
text: Screen readers hear the remaining time at intervals, not every second.
